authentication.description: Project API key from /app/developer, or an OAuth access token

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the projects this credential can reach. Start here when you do not know the project id.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a workspace for a brand. Only needed once per brand you monitor.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List what is currently being watched: keywords, aliases, sources and whether each monitor is active.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Start watching a brand, product or competitor. Include every spelling people actually use — the domain and the @handle as well as the name — because matching is literal.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Change a monitor’s keywords, sources or active state. Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: delete_monitor
tools.description: Permanently remove a monitor. Mentions already collected are kept. Prefer update_monitor with active:false if the user may want it back.

tools.name: list_mentions
tools.description: The main read tool. Returns collected posts newest first, already classified. Call with no arguments for the latest, or filter by category, sentiment, urgency, source or a named time window. Page with the returned nextCursor.

tools.name: get_mention
tools.description: Fetch one mention in full, with its AI classification and a link to the original post.

tools.name: update_mention_status
tools.description: Move a mention through triage. Use done once it has been handled and ignored when it is not really about the brand.

tools.name: get_mention_analytics
tools.description: Counts for a window — totals, relevance rate, how many need attention, and breakdowns by category, sentiment and source. Use this to answer "how are we doing" without paging the whole feed.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List alert rules — what triggers a notification and where it is sent.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Notify an email address or https webhook when a matching mention arrives. Empty filter arrays mean "any".

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Permanently remove an alert rule. Notifications stop immediately.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Plan, mentions used against the quota, and what collection cost this period. Check before creating monitors if the user is near their limit.

resources.name: Capability catalog
resources.description: Every tool, its required scope, its annotations and its documentation URL.

resources.name: Domain glossary
resources.description: What the categories, statuses, urgency scores and sources mean.

prompts.name: triage_inbox
prompts.description: Review everything new and hand back a short, prioritised list of what to act on.

prompts.name: weekly_digest
prompts.description: A short written summary of the week, suitable for pasting into a team channel.

prompts.name: set_up_monitoring
prompts.description: Set up monitoring for a brand from scratch, including competitors.

prompts.name: find_leads
prompts.description: Find people publicly asking for what this product does.
